messages:
sarah: Heads up — late-night spike of 5xxs on hosted-us-east hitting /v1/generate. Customers hitting timeouts. Observing ~30% 502s and some 504s. spinning up this thread to track.
warroom-bot: INCIDENT CREATED • hosted-us-east • high 5xx spike • incident id ir-2026-1756667777 • runbook: hosted-5xx -> join #oncall if needed
 mike: seeing same in dashboard, p50 latency up from 120ms -> 900ms. 502s start ~1756667600. any recent deploys?
 lina: no deploys in the last 4h from ci.100. Checked autoscaler events: no large scale churn.
 ops_lead: @mike can you paste proxy logs for a request example? want to know if upstream returned error or proxy timed out.
 mike: snippet from apigw logs: ```
{"ts":1756667612,"req_id":"r-9a7","path":"/v1/generate","status":502,"upstream_status":504,"lat_ms":1800}
{"ts":1756667613,"req_id":"r-9a8","path":"/v1/generate","status":502,"error":"upstream_reset"}
```
 lina: KV-cache metrics: small uptick in misses but not correlated. batcher queue depth normal. kvcache hit rate ~89%.
 support_julia: Support seeing multiple customer tickets: timeouts and partial responses. Two enterprise customers reported client-side retries spiking. They're asking ETA.
 samir: I'm attaching a short trace from a failing request (trace-id t-44): proxy -> router -> runtime-pool -> runtime returned 504 after 1.6s; router retried once and returned 502. Looks like long tail in runtime.
 sarah: good catch @samir. any pattern by model or seq len?
 samir: quick grep: >85% of errors for this window are model xlarge-v2 and sequences >1024. small models fine.
 ops_lead: hypothesis: runtime worker busy/kv cache stall for large-seqlen paths causing timeouts -> fallback retries causing 502s. mitigation: 1) increase runtime timeouts to 3s for large model variants 2) enable immediate fallback to smaller variant for high latency 3) throttle client burst for affected routes.
 lina: can confirm runtime backlog for xlarge-v2: worker queues showing p99 exec time ~1.4s; but memory GC spikes occasionally on workers pinned to those models.
 mike: rolling a config change to edge: extend proxy upstream timeout from 1.2s -> 2.8s for /v1/generate route (canary 10% now).
 sarah: doing customer comms: acknowledging incident, suggesting retry with exponential backoff. @support_julia paste standard note?
 support_julia: sending: "We're investigating higher-than-normal timeouts on generation endpoints. Recommend reducing client concurrency and adding 2s backoff. We'll update in 30m"
 warroom-bot: CONFIG CANARY deployed to 10% of edge as of 1756667815 by mike.
 lina: monitoring shows canary reduced 502s for that 10% slice immediately. overall 5xx rate dropping from 30% -> 18% after canary.
 samir: started a temporary autoscale bump for runtime pool serving xlarge-v2 (+30% capacity). Should be up in ~2m.
 ops_lead: good. continue to monitor for 15m. if p50 latency normalizes and 5xxs drop -> rollback timeout change? or leave until patch?
 mike: timeout change is reversible. recommending keep until we deploy runtime fix for GC spikes.
 sarah: quick repro steps for on-call / support engineers: 1) curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"model":"xlarge-v2","input":"<~1.5k tokens>"}' 2) observe 502/504 in failing window 3) attach proxy logs with req_id
 lina: root cause initial theory: large-sequence workloads + model xlarge-v2 GC/execution tail causing upstream timeouts -> proxy retries causing 502s.
 samir: planned followups: 1) patch runtime to reduce GC pauses and improve preemptive batching (deploy next 6h) 2) add model routing rule to avoid heavy xlarge-v2 for high-concurrency customers (ASAP) 3) improve observability: add per-model p99 exec time alert.
 support_julia: capturing customer comms cadence: initial ack sent, follow-up in 30m, postmortem + RCA to customers in 24h for impacted accounts.
 ops_lead: action items (owner / ETA): - runtime GC patch (samir / 6h) - temporary autoscale policy for xlarge-v2 (lina / 30m) - edge timeout canary rollback decision (mike / monitor 15m) - customer email + notes (support_julia / 30m) - postmortem writeup (sarah / 24h)
 sarah: status check in 15m. thanks all — keep replies inline. :thumbsup:
